entities.summary: Ventura García-Sancho e Ibarrondo, 1st Count of Consuegra better known by his spouse's title Marquess of Aguilar de Campoo, was a Mexican-Spanish nobleman and politician who served twice as Minister of State and as Mayor of Madrid between 1899 and 1900.
